terminal.emulator: direct PTY with deterministic loopback HTTP/SSE completed tool-call fixture

reference.capture: fresh synthetic-home Hermes TUI process with one ordinary prompt, a complete clarify tool-call stream, bounded arrow navigation and one Enter selection on the rendered question surface, and a bounded post-answer observation window

normalization: The reference checkout, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, prompt text, assistant text, tool arguments, credentials, authorization values, session identifiers, timestamps, and redraw bytes are omitted or represented by stable markers or digests.

The provider is a deterministic 127.0.0.1 fixture owned by the probe; all recorded HTTP traffic stayed on that loopback endpoint and no external network, OAuth flow, browser, tool response, or user credential was used.

The response retains OpenAI-compatible tool-call delta shape and argument-fragment lengths/digests without copying argument payloads; the [DONE] marker completes the stream so the post-completion question surface can be interacted with.

clarify is interactive-only; exercising its TUI question surface with arrow navigation and one Enter selection involves no external side effect and does not turn the reference handoff into Hades execution behavior.
The real Hermes tool-result content is recorded only as normalized shape (role, content kind, length, digest, structural markers and JSON top-level keys); the content itself is never persisted.

The probe harness strips desktop-app environment leakage (HERMES_DESKTOP, PYTHONPATH) from the reference child so the observation matches the plain-CLI reference environment; the request advertises the anchored 31-tool inventory.

steps.precondition: Fresh Hermes TUI at 120x40 with an isolated synthetic HERMES_HOME and a configured custom provider at the probe-owned loopback endpoint.

input_sequence.value: clarify question surface rendered (question and choice markers visible)

side_effect_boundary.external_network: none observed; all recorded HTTP traffic stayed on the synthetic loopback
side_effect_boundary.credentials: none; only a synthetic key was placed in the throwaway config and auth values were reduced to presence booleans
side_effect_boundary.filesystem: reference runtime state was confined to the throwaway HOME/HERMES_HOME and removed after the probe; no tool-specific path or result was observed
side_effect_boundary.tool_action: clarify is interactive-only; only arrow navigation and one Enter selection on the TUI question surface were exercised, with no external side effect

unknowns: Whether the observed question-surface cursor semantics and tool-result shape are stable across reference restarts; the exact completion/approval/failure semantics remain intentionally bounded by this single fresh observation.
Provider-specific retries, malformed or truncated argument handling, multiple calls per turn, approval policy, and post-handoff failure behavior remain unknown.
The purpose of the auxiliary non-stream request seen in OBS-0108/0109/0114/0116 remains unclassified and is not a Hades requirement.
Cursor-row marker granularity on the question surface was not isolated at cell level in this bounded observation; choice presence/absence markers were recorded instead.

The reference child environment is sanitized of desktop-app leakage (HERMES_DESKTOP, PYTHONPATH) so the request advertises the anchored 31-tool inventory; other environment-dependent schema text may still vary and remains outside this fixture's claim.
